question: Do the frozen DON8/EMA8/VOL8 rules, combined as the equal-capital v3 portfolio, earn positive net returns on 2020-06..2023-12 MEXC data that no protocol, parameter choice or study in this repository has used?
registration_note: Registered 2026-09-26, before any strategy result on this window was computed. A repository-wide search found no reference to any date before 2024 in src/, scripts/, config/, docs/, research/ or integrations/. Strategy parameters were frozen on 2024-01-01..2026-09-12. Only MEXC kline availability (listing dates and bar counts) was checked on this window.
evaluation_rule: run exactly once from a commit containing this file; any rerun must reproduce the same numbers from the same data hash

late_listing.SUI_USDT: 2023-05-03; its sleeves join when their data starts

economics.funding: not charged: MEXC funding history is not available before 2025-04. The 2025-26 crypto funding drag was 1.0%/yr, and it is reported alongside as a known bias.
economics.portfolio: equal capital across sleeves that have data that day, rebalanced daily at 00:00 UTC

primary.test: Newey-West t (5 lags) of the mean daily net return
primary.direction: one hypothesis, stated in advance; no alternative series or window may replace it

secondary_descriptive: the same portfolio with inverse-vol entry sizing (universal-cross-asset-trend-invvol-forward-v1 constants)

interpretation_limits: Backward holdout, not forward: 2021's boom and 2022's crash are general knowledge, although no parameter was fitted to them.
Nine coins; about 2 effective independent bets (see FIRST_PRINCIPLES_EVIDENCE_RATE_2026_09_26.md).
A pass is supporting evidence, not promotion; a fail is recorded, and the rules are not retuned.
